reviews.text: I’ve gotten them all and love each and everyone of them!! I used everyday and have seen amazing results
reviews.zh: 我全部都買咗，每一樣都好鍾意！！我每日都用，見到效果好好。

reviews.text: I bought this hand cream because of the packaging. The scent is okay and the texture is fine too. There's nothing exceptional or amazing. This hand cream is not bad in anyway but not special either; it's average.
reviews.zh: 我係因為包裝先買呢支護手霜。香味還可以，質地都幾好。冇乜特別出色或者好驚喜嘅地方。呢支護手霜唔係話差，但都冇咩特別；普普通通。

reviews.text: best hand cream on the market...nothing hydrates my hand better and every smell is great
reviews.zh: 市面上最好用嘅護手霜……冇一樣可以令我雙手更加保濕，每種味道都好好聞。

reviews.text: The packaging is so aesthetically pleasing and therapeutic. The scent is lovely, and I really appreciate that it’s not sticky at all.
reviews.zh: 包裝好有美感，好療癒。香味好可愛，我好欣賞佢完全唔黏手。

reviews.text: I got a pleasure scent. I don't like the smell, but i like the texure of cream. Also really cute packaging
reviews.zh: 我買咗 Pleasure 味。我唔鍾意個味，但係好鍾意膏體質地。包裝都好得意。

reviews.text: Scent is light and pleasant. Very good for moisturizing and keeping hands soft.
reviews.zh: 香味清淡舒服。保濕效果好好，令雙手保持柔軟。

reviews.text: I bought this because of the packaging and it was a gift for my friend and she really liked it.
reviews.zh: 我係因為包裝先買，佢係送畀朋友嘅禮物，朋友好鍾意。

reviews.text: a bit sticky but not very watery which i like in my hand creams. if you like lighter hand creams, this probably isn’t for you
reviews.zh: 有少少黏，但唔會好清水，呢點我好鍾意喺護手霜度。如果你鍾意質地清爽啲嘅護手霜，呢支可能唔啱你。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
